heading: Number.
text: Unless the contrary appears from the context, words importing the singular number include the plural number, and words importing the plural number include the singular number.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
